reviews.title: Choose another airline
reviews.text: Used this airline a few times going London to Dubai or vice versa because it was a little cheaper than other airlines. The online check-in never works. Tried iphone/laptop/android and have never been able to check in for one of these flights. Then join a large queue (and arrive to airport early) unnecessarily as I don't take bags just to get a boarding pass. Not worth the difference in price. Go for BA/Emirates for better flight (and for the tech to actually work)
reviews.author: Explorer544348

reviews.title: DO NOT GIVE YOUR MONEY TO THIS AIRLINE. THEY WILL REFUSE COMPENSATION.
reviews.text: Absolutely awful airline, with even worst customer service. We arrived in Melbourne on 28th Feb 2023, only to find that my luggage was missing. I got it back after 2 MONTHS and had to spend all my savings on new clothes and medication. The journey to getting it back was absolutely appaling. My emails and calls were being ignored to the point where I was trying to contact them every day. I ended up going through Facebook messenger. They finally got back to me saying they have found my suitcase and will contact me when it is on the way. 2 days later and the WRONG suitcase arrived with no indication it was on the way, AFTER I had asked them to check the contents inside before the sent it. So then I ended up with some poor woman's suitcase in my garage. Fast foward another month, and my mother all the way back in England was also trying to contact them as we were being IGNORED!! FINALLY my suitcase turned up, not thanks to Royal Brunei, but to the luggage company in London/Melbourne (Menzies I believe). I have been trying to contact Royal Brunei for a further 3 weeks now about the compensation they owe me (they should pay me a certain amount for each day I was without my case and then some!!) STILL NO LUCK and yet again being ignored after resorting to contacting them about 4 times a week. They clearly do not want to take responsibility for the amount of financial and mental stress they have caused me, yet alone pay me the compensation I deserve. They are withholding my money and
reviews.author: Abbie S

reviews.title: DO NOT SPEND YOUR MONEY WITH THIS AIRLINE.
reviews.text: I've never left a review of anything in my life, If I have a bad experience I just don't use something again. HOWEVER after flying with Royal Brunei you realise how much of a useless money hungry neglectful business they are. For context, me and my partner flew from London to Melbourne with them. On arrival at baggage claim, after 3 hours of waiting my partners luggage didn't turn up. We were told by the airline we would recieve compensation and her bag shortly. A whole month later her bag was still lost and with no update as to where it was, they stopped responding to emails and calls. We did recieve the luggage two weeks later, however no compensation and no sign of it. We spent in total about £2000 on our flights and have recieved NO customer service. Just don't. They suck
reviews.author: Jack

reviews.title: Worst food and outdated plane.
reviews.text: We flew from dubai to london, it was very smooth until we got our food, the first meal was pizza it contained sand in it, when the next meal came the crew denied veg meal for our daughter despite pre ordering but we managed to get one after another crew got involved.
reviews.author: A J

reviews.title: The worst experience ever for a frequent flyer!
reviews.text: My first flight was delayed by 14 hours, then second flight was delayed 5 hours then brought forward again to 2 hours after the original flight making it a nightmare to get the the airport. The airline lost both my bags, one has fortunately showed up but the other is still missing. I am an expat so am frequently flying with many different airlines and never in my life have I experience such an awful service. I would stay well away even if it’s a cheaper flight! Definitely not worth the stress I have been through in the last 2 weeks.
reviews.author: Phillippa C

reviews.title: If you're doing some research on Royal Brunei before you go ahead and book your budget ticket, PLEASE READ THIS FIRST.
reviews.text: I am currently sat in Muscat international airport (Oman). My flight however is from London Heathrow, stopping at Brunei and then Manila. I departed at 17.15pm in London on the 2nd of April and I am typing this on the 4th of April at around 7am local time in Oman. I was supposed to land in Manila at around 9pm on the 3rd... So first class experience started with the online check-in service which did not work at all and would not let me do it after several attempts. When me and my partner checked in at the airport, the girl and the desk sat us both apart so we had an 8 hour trip to Dubai sitting separately. This is forgivable but I am including this as it gets so much worse. We landed in Dubai and the flight was fine, no complaints. When I originally booked this ticket, it was sold to me as a refuel in Dubai (so you remain on the plane) and then a change over in Brunei. So 2 stops but quick turnovers and only one airport to go through security. However when we got to Dubai, the captain announced we still had to get off to go through security to then come straight back onto the exact same plane and same seat. Ok? Once this was done, we were told that there was going to be a delay of around 20 minutes due to a 'technical' problem. This 20 minutes turned into 2 hours. What was happening was the plane would taxi onto the runway and then lose all power, so incredibly reassuring before reaching 40k ft at 500mph. Both times this happened, they parked the plane back up and then an eng
reviews.author: Will T

reviews.title: DO NOT TRAVEL TO  AUSTRALIA FROM UK WITH THIS AIRLINE!
reviews.text: I am travelling to Australia with my wife, and my two children. We fly regularly long haul to Australia, Malaysia, USA and as such we are all accustomed to long haul flights. We purposely pick flights with short stop overs and ensure the days we travel allow for sleep eg travel afternoon or evening rather than early morning. We picked Royal Brunei as the flights were good take off times, short stopovers and on the correct dates of travel. My wife and I are now deeply upset that we have taken time off work that we can not change Royal Brunei have changed the flights. Summary: 1) They have cancelled our outgoing flight which was 1 stop from London to Melbourne. The new flight is two stops from London to Melbourne but both stops are short and the take off time is afternoon still, so not too bad. 2) They have cancelled part of our return flight - from Brunei to London and the alternative flight no longer connects with the flight from Melbourne. 3) They have put us on a flight from Melbourne to brunei more than a day earlier - approx 32 hours earlier. 4) They have taken us off the flight from Brunei to London on the day I booked and put me on a flight a day earlier and refuse to change this. 5) The original flight was 1 stop return from Melbourne to london on the dates we required and with a short stop over. we now are have stop overs over 10 hours in total and are flying home over a day earlier than we booked. 6) instead of an afternoon flight the new flight is now early morning

reviews.title: Thank you!
reviews.text: I would like to thank Dk. ASYAHDATUL A3100 (SENIOR) and SITI NYRUL HAZIYANA AU677 and DK. NAQIAH A4671 for taking especially good care of me . I had a very bad anxiety on the flight to BRUNEI. THEY took Exceptionally good care of me . THANK YOU SO MUCH! KEEP UP THE GOOD WORK! I would definitely fly with Royal Brunei Airline's again.
reviews.author: Irene Y

reviews.title: Scam company, don't use it!
reviews.text: They can change your flight to anytime any date and ask you to pay extra AU$200 for a refund if the change doesn't fit you! I have brought the flight from Melbourne to Tokyo with transition in Brunei.I was told the flight time was being changed from 1200 to 0600 on 18/5. However as I live in Tasmania, and paid for the non refundable ticket from Tasmania to Melbourne for the flight departure at 0855 .I could not get the flight connected and even if I book a new flight from Tasmania,the only possible flight I could book would be the flight arriving at 2200 on 17/5. That means I have to stay for extra 8 hrs while waiting for the flight and need to wait for extra 6hrs while waiting for the transition,in total 14 extra hrs of waiting time. As the change is causing my lost to rebook a new flight and leading to a further longer waiting time, I am hoping to get a refund without any extra fee charged. They just simply refused,saying that I am not booking the domestic flight and international flight together. Their option to me is either I have to pay AU$200 for the refund or they can change my resheduled flight from18/5 0600 to 20/5 1200.But it is them changing my flight time without my permission, not me.And now they are refusing my full refund while not providing the service I paid for!
reviews.author: Ming C

reviews.title: If going to australia from UK consider Royal Brunei
reviews.text: I recently visited Melbourne travelling outbound on the 19th Feb inbound 7th March 2023. Originally having been priced out of the trip by all other airlines. Online I came across an airline that appears to get no advertising in the UK. So after constant searching you come across Royal Bruneii who appear to offer a very reasonable price that the average Joe can afford. So you visit the the Web page. WHAT You find is that the price advertised is legitimate. So what can I say. VERY IMPRESSED. Economy Class we paid £1080 return including the cost of the seat booking reservation. The inflight food is very good and in my opinion is better than some of the bigger airlines that I have flown with. For economy class the seat pitch is awesome with plenty of leg room. The one downside to the flight is that being a Muslim airline they do not serve alcohol on the flight but your are allowed to bring your own on board but this must be consumed by the time you get To Bandar Seri Begwan (outbound your 2nd stopover inbound 1st stopover). Anyway waffle over. ROYAL BRUNEI airlines. PRICE - Very Affordable. FOOD - Very Good. LEG ROOM - Very Good PUNCTUALITY -My experience - On time. INFLIGHT HOSPITALITY - Cabin crew very good. INFLGHT ENTERTAINMENT - As good as any other. My overall Rating has to be 10/10 and I would happily recommend and again fly with Royal Brunei. Phil Bollington
reviews.author: Phil B

reviews.title: RBA prefers to beleive a flawed IT system rather than passengers
reviews.text: Having had a bad experience with cancelled flight then cancelled booking on return sector I tried complaining. Was told that the IT system showed that my reservation was not cancelled but that (24 hours before planned departure) I had chosen to purchase a higher cost economy ticket- and somehow had decided to voluntarily pay a $100 penalty
reviews.author: Wes H

reviews.title: Fligh cancelled at short notice and had to buy extra ticket for return
reviews.text: Flight to Brunei cancelled at short notice and was offered seat in 5 days time. Eventually reached Brunei 3 days later via Singapore. On the evening prior to return discovered return booking had been cancelled and was required to buy an additional ticket. Also lost 3 paid for 'reserved seats' which were never given- ended up squeezed into corner. Complained and requested refund of extra ticket and after a week still no response from any of the 3 'customer service' contacts.
reviews.author: Wes H

reviews.title: 1 star, only becasue minus 5 is not an option
reviews.text: TERRIBLE AT EVERY TURN. Arrived 60 hours late and spent more than 4 months trying to get promised compensation. Lies at every turn. Do Not Fly with this airline, they will lie to you and delay and delay and delay
reviews.author: david w

reviews.title: Don’t trust this airline
reviews.text: Royal brunei Over the last 8 years me and my wife have routinely flown to Melbourne Australia with Royale Brunei and have never had a problem. This all changed on our first trip with them after Covid. We booked a January 2023 return flight to Melbourne with Royale Brunei back in June 2022 for my wife and 2 children. With one of our children being 7 months old and the other 2 years we booked with Royale Brunei as they offered one of the lowest flights times, around 22 hours. Booking this far in advanced also meant we could secure bassinet seats for our baby. In mid November 2022 I received a SMS message stating one of my flights had changed and I was to log into the website for further information. After checking the booking, the flight duration had increased by around 7 hours bringing the total flight time to around 28 hours there and back. After further investigation it appear the airline had suddenly made the decision to stop at Dubai on our flights between London and Brunei. On top of that, our bassinet seats had been wiped out of the booking for the outbound London > Dubai > Brunei leg of the flight. The online seat selector was now showing these seats as being blocked out and unselectable. At this point we decided to give their London office a call to found out what was going on. Little did we know this was a whole other issue in itself. You just couldn’t get through to anyone. When calling it would be pot luck whether you would get a pre recorded voice mail system askin
reviews.author: Caney12

reviews.title: Excellent airline
reviews.text: I've flown Royal Brunei a number of times on the punishing Melbourne to London flight. It rates very highly on all the things that count: comfort, cleanliness, leg room, reliability & service. It is also well priced. The zero alcohol policy also lowers the nuisance risk. 5 stars!
reviews.author: Grant P

reviews.title: Thank you for the kindness
reviews.text: I want to thank the whole off Royal Brunei ground crew, both in KLIA & Bandar Seri Begawan. That despite being unable to board due to an unforeseen circumstances on my part, the kindness and assistance given by the crew has been like a glass of cold water in the middle of the desert. I cannot thank you enough. All the best to Royal Brunei. Keep up the good work.
reviews.author: Resni

reviews.title: The flights you buy is not what they will fly
reviews.text: I purchased London to Melbourne return flights in July 2022 for Christmas, a great flight option at 22 hours via Brunei (with a 2 hour layover in Brunei) each way. Then in November, I coincidentally was looking at Skyscanner for my dates, and noticed Royal Brunei were advertising at 32 hour flight, so I checked my emails, nothing, so checked the Royal Brunei site logging into ‘access my booking’, and low and behold, my 22 hour flight each way had become 32 hours to Melbourne (with a technical stop in Dubai and a 7 hour layover in Brunei), and my return flight was 50 hours (with a 28 hour layover in Brunei and technical stop in Dubai). Of course I called them straight away, and the best they could manage was getting me flights to be 32 hours each way. I made the decision to book with a superior airline at a higher cost (what I wish I did at the start in July) and cancel the Royal Brunei flights. Royal Brunei cancelled my booking on the 2nd November 2022 and confirmed the refund process had started with an estimated date of 4 - 6 weeks (early - mid December). Here we are on 20th January with no refund, and I have been chasing Royal Brunei weekly without a single response since 28th December. I cannot recommend to people anymore to just spend the extra money for a higher ranked airline, because whatever you think you are saving in money, you will lose in time and stress.
reviews.author: Nicholas B

reviews.title: Flight Changes constantly
reviews.text: I had booked flights for my children from London to Australia - every single flight I booked (5 people at different dates) was changed to less convenient times than we booked. The final one of these has now been changed to leaving 2 days later than when we booked meaning that my son will have 2 days taken from his 2 weeks holiday in Australia. I would not book with this airline ever again and would advise any people who know me not to touch them with a bargepole.
reviews.author: Stewart H

reviews.title: Travel Disaster via Royal Brunei
reviews.text: i who took your flight from Thai => Brunei => Heathrow. My airline booking reference no is 13J7RF. You must wonder why you receive this email because I've never had such an unpleasant flying experience as this time via Royal Brunei Airline. First, I found my 2nd flight from Brunei to Heathrow UK being changed from 00:40 to 22:50 on Jan 1 during checking in online via my cell phone 3 hours before the onboard time. However, they couldn't provide me with any support and suggested I consulted the Royal Brunei staff after I arrived at the Brunei Airport. reviews.title: Deceptive and misleading conduct
reviews.text: Just checked in online to find that seats we had pre purchased have been allocated to others and we have been automatically allocated seats that separate our family, incl. children under the age of 14. Called customer service in Brunei to sort it out and were told there are no options available to us except a refund. Excuse is when there is a schedule change (flight is leaving an hour later) the internal system wipes out all pre-paid options. Absolutely disgraceful. Especially since no auto re-fund option is triggered/offered at the time of flight change. You are a SHAME to Brunei as its national carrier RBA. Be better!
reviews.author: Rspmegna

reviews.title: Terrible experience of uncertainity of travel from booking to check-in and completing journey.
reviews.text: Worst ever airline I have ever flown and I have lost 3 valuable days of my much saught afer trip to Australia due to a blunder of the airline and their compurter system. There is no one to speak to from the airline at the airport and their office in London is useless with no one answering the phone during their office hours even (works from 9-5 only) . No agent at airport and passengers are left with no advice or information/update whatsoever. Me and my family endured 3 miserable days at airport having lost flight and money spent on another connection flight from Melbourne. Messages sent to airline remain unanswered todate. I would not recommend anyone to book a flight with this airline and risk their journey. In flight service with some legs, had only two options of food after less than half the flight served and air hosts become arrogant and rude when inquired.
reviews.author: Nandana A

reviews.title: decent airline - great stopover
reviews.text: Clean cabin, friendly cabin crew, decent in-flight entertainment, good food (especially the croissants for breakfast). Even better than the flight was the opportunity to spend the night in the delightfully serene country of Brunei. Would definitely travel this way again.
reviews.author: smalldog257

reviews.title: baggage delay is too long!
reviews.text: It’s been almost 5 DAYS! No updates were our baggages whereabouts. Doesn’t answer our call. Make false promises, told us that our bags will come the next day. BUT WHERE? Such a disappointment for an “world’s leading cabin crew”!! I’m so pissed because I have my precious pillow in that luggage they left in Bangkok!
reviews.author: Bella

reviews.title: Good flights
reviews.text: Travelled 3 flights going from Heathrow to Melbourne. Each stage had a flight time of around 7 hours. Initially the flight was from Heathrow to Bendar, which would have been really long, but we refuelled at Dubai. Dreamliner 787 so it was a large plane, very comfortable. We were around an hour late from Heathrow but still seemed to land at Melbourne on time. Check in at Heathrow was a test of endurance but it was Christmas Day and very busy. Cabin crew were excellent, very helpful and cheerful. My only suggestion to Royal Brunei would be to sell bottles of water/pop etc on the plane. The little cups of water that come with the meals are not enough on a long flight. You can also have tea/coffee but once the meal is over, you have to call cabin crew if you want a drink. Snacks would be a good idea too. This is the first time flying for me where the hasn't been the option of purchasing refreshments. Other than that it was a positive experience and I would happily fly with them again, but would know to bring my own drinks/snacks.
reviews.author: Estelle R

reviews.title: Mrs.
reviews.text: Lost two days of my holiday due to both my flights being cancelled & my day at The Melbourne cup No communication whatsoever from airline staff. Information relayed by other traveller. Never ever fly with this airline again Return flight Dec 4th delayed 2.30 hours at Melbourne & 2.10 at Brunei
reviews.author: Gabriel G

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: Terrible experience - avoid at all costs. I won’t fly with Royal Brunei again. My flights were moved at short notice leaving me a >24 hr stopover in Brunei and getting me home a day late, and both legs were then delayed by more than 2 hours each. An additional (and unannounced) stop in Dubai was added, at which we were all required to disembark and go back through security - essentially adding another changeover. In each case - no comms, no apology, no compensation, no support, no offer of refreshment, accommodation etc
reviews.author: bachallis

reviews.title: Do not travel with royal Brunei
reviews.text: Absolutely appalling company. Do not travel. Our flight was cancelled 5 days before departure. The extra leg room flights we paid £300 for were not given to us. The flight in total was over 3 hours delayed. I have sent 5 emails to customer care. 3 weeks later I have yet to receive any response at all. There's no way to seek compensation or an apology. The fairs were cheaper but there's a reason for that. Would never fly again and wouldn't recommend flying with them.
reviews.author: Jenny

reviews.title: NOT BABY FRIENDLY
reviews.text: If you want a kind, helpful, caring airline when travelling with children then I suggest you look elsewhere. Firstly you have to pay a huge amount to have a bassinet seat. Secondly, LHR RBA didn't let families board first. If you call customer care in London (like I did for 3 weeks to book a bassinet seat) then you are put on hold and then it cuts you off saying they are too busy. The only way I got a paid for bassinet seat was by having a family member GO IN to an office in Bandar. Ludicrous. Travelling with a baby makes you a passenger with high needs for support and I felt totally abandoned especially as I was travelling alone. Talking to ex RBA staff I know in Bandar, they were shocked and mortified that you are not automatically given a bassinet anymore or extra help from RBA. The aim for a bassinet seat is to help the parent and child PLUS help reduce stress and disruption to other passengers. It should therefore be automatic to assign these seats to mothers etc instead of focusing on money making. Note: onboard staff were kind and there were no issues there. They got the bassinet ready as soon as they could after takeoff.
reviews.author: Emily W

reviews.title: Complete lack of customer service
reviews.text: Booked a business flight London- melbourne for December with a 2 hr stopover in Brunei. They have now informed me that this flight is cancelled and flight will go via Dubai AND Brunei with a 7 hour layover. Tried to complain by phone (1 hr wait,) and was told if I didn't like it i could cancel! Trying to reschedule business class costs over £8000 at his late stage. I have written a complaint 3 weeks ago and heard nothing. I booked the original flight because It was a 1-stop flight with a 2 hour layover. Its now a 2 stop flight with 7 hours layover. I have medical conditons and this is not OK. Being told my only option is to accept this new flight or cancel is unacceptable. this is NOT what i booked and paid for.customer service - non existent. Do not fly with them, they can do anything they like once you've paid.
reviews.author: Tabby46

reviews.title: Worst airline
reviews.text: Booked and paid for flights to Dubai in December 2022. Received confirmation. Unfortunately, 2 months prior to the trip they changed all the dates and times of the flights such that all connecting flights leave a full day before we can catch them. My partner and I have tried to contact the airlines to no avail. We have been put on hold for up to 1h30m and transferred through every department (none of them seem to be able to process a full refund of flexible, insured tickets, so we can purchase tickets with another airline). We attempted going through webjet as well. We have been offered credit with the same airline through webjet - which we obviously do not want. Cheaper is not always better. Please book with reputable airlines, because inconvenience costs.
reviews.author: Wachizya N
